main.description: The app.nearhorizon.plural.member records of one account, member or not, in ascending rkey order. No auth; charged by IP. 'status': 'complete' when every member is listed across the pages, 'partial' when the AppView cannot promise that (a very large system, the stream behind, a member it could not show), 'unknown' when it has not listed the repository (members empty; ask again). Cache-control as getRecords.
